basis: Configured study themes and methods; no unpublished findings or full thesis supplied

today.q: How do you rule out alternative explanations for differences in ecological functions between settlement types?
outline: Differentiate spatial associations from causal effects
Compare formal, informal flatland, and hillside morphology
Control for baseline and scale confounding factors
today.pitfall: Attributing ecological function differences strictly to settlement status without causality proof.
today.follow_up: What spatial statistical methods test whether morphology rather than baseline causes the shift?
today.bring: Analytical matrix separating spatial correlation from causal settlement drivers.
